description: Nopan is the performance platform for account and wallet payments. Founded by former Netflix payments leaders, Nopan helps digital businesses and Payment Service Providers launch, optimise and scale account-based and wallet payment methods across Europe. By focusing exclusively on account and wallet payments, Nopan combines specialist infrastructure, operational expertise and performance optimisation to help turn payment methods into measurable business outcomes.

Lightbringer automates, streamlines, and digitizes the entire patent lifecycle, from creation and filings to prosecution and ongoing management of patent portfolios. Real patent attorneys provide the judgment, while AI handles the heavy lifting. As a result, patent work is no longer constrained by manual workflows, billable hours, or surprise invoices.

TurnUp uses AI to predict no-show appointments in healthcare (with the dental space as a starting point). From there, they optimize capacity planning for the healthcare practice, handle patient communication, and gradually automate front office operations.

NjiaPay offers a payment management system for African Merchants to help them accept online payments and increasing the payment success rate. Through a single API, merchants gain access to multiple Payment Service Providers intelligent routing, redundancy, fraud prevention, and a unified checkout experience that reduces friction. All this translates into higher conversion rates and more revenue.

Agileday's professional services automation (PSA) platform connects talent, allocations, timesheets, and project financials for services firms, eliminating silos, surfacing smarter decisions, and turning talent into growth drivers.Unlike legacy tools designed for top-down control and reporting, Agileday is people-first by design. Every feature is built to engage teams, not just track them.
Birdsview powers an online retailer's customer communications end to end, enabling agents to send personalized messages to every customer and drive repeat purchases.

clockin is building a software that digitizes HR and project processes of ‘deskless’ SMBs in Europe. That includes functionality such as time tracking, absence management, resource planning, documentation, etc.

SEQUESTO, based in Ghent and founded in 2020, is building a platform that supports tender teams with advanced, AI-driven technology that automates repetitive, error-prone, and time-consuming tasks. The platform structurally reduces content management costs, accelerates time-to-value, and demonstrably increases the win rate on complex RFx processes.

nuwacom is building a platform that enables marketing and communication teams to harness the power of GenAI in content generation. With strong emphasis on compliance and scalability, nuwacom’s platform is specifically designed for the needs of enterprises to drive the adoption of secure AI in organizations.

Koppla, based in Berlin and founded in 2020, has developed a construction project scheduling and planning product. This solution can be considered a modern, industry-specific iteration of traditional project planning tools such as Oracle Primavera and Microsoft Project.

PartsCloud supports machine OEMs in their spare parts operations and after sales logistics. The mission is to become the operating system for the spare parts business, to consistently improve OEMs ability to get the right spare part to the right place at the right time.
AI-driven Predictive Retention Platform, empowering subscription businesses with predictive insights and prescriptive actions to retain, reactivate, and upsell customers.

Neople is on a mission to solve customer support challenges. Consumers demand high-quality support, but support teams struggle with high workloads. Neople solves this problem by offering a digital co-worker. By now, over 100 leading Dutch and German e-commerce businesses have hired a Neople.
As the world’s 1st modular product management tool, airfocus addresses core enterprise challenges like roadmapping, prioritization, customer insights, and OKR alignment with unmatched flexibility.
Ellie.ai is a Product Design and Collaboration platform for data teams.

With the power of AI, delphai revolutionizes big data and ingests millions of websites, press releases, job postings, and more every week to create a single source of business truth: A near real-time, highly accurate hub of company data that is accessible via a dashboard, API, or integration.

Occtoo is an Experience Data Platform that helps digital teams create relevant customer experiences with speed. Occtoos API technology is the missing piece in a modern composable stack by easily connecting all data, content and APIs, enabling speed in the “idea-to-deployment” process and ability to quickly build new custom applications.
VIKTOR is the low-code platform empowering engineers to build and share user-friendly web apps with nothing but Python.

Alleo (f.k.a. YourCampus) contributes to structurally better compensation for employees with attractive benefits packages. On the innovative Alleo platform, employees can compile these packages themselves, based on a budget allocated to them.
LegionellaDossier eases legionella prevention and control in buildings. LegionellaDossier’s main mission is to guarantee safe drinking water.

Parloa is a leading Conversational AI platform for automating omni-channel customer service. Parloa’s software combines automated speech recognition and natural language understanding to enable companies to build automated dialogs for phone, chat, voice assistants & messenger – all in one place.

Prepr is the world’s first data-driven headless CMS. Prepr offers a new approach to headless CMS, as it allows to centralize content of different brands and helps to deliver and personalize digital content at scale for exceptional customer experiences.

Founded 2016 in Copenhagen, Passendo has set out to commercialising newsletter inventory. Their state of the art email ad server and SSP provides value for publishers and advertisers worldwide, with over 4,000 premium publishing house newsletter inventories across the world.

Salonkee is the all-in-one solution for online booking tool and management software for hairdresser-, beauty- and wellness salons. Founded in 2018 in Luxembourg it now has a strong presence in Belgium, Switzerland & Germany.

Dexter offers services to energy retailers and large-scale energy consumers to reduce power imbalance. The services consist of forecasting energy loads on asset-level or cluster-level as well as forecasting of short-term electricity prices.

Filestage is the enterprise-ready online proofing software that helps teams to get their work reviewed and approved faster. Filestage streamlines, organizes and automates feedback on files throughout the proofing process, while reducing errors and ensuring compliance guides are met.

Objective Platform, is a marketing measurement and prediction software designed to track and optimize multi-channel media investments. By maximizing the use of available data sources, marketing measurement models offer a holistic view across digital and traditional media without sacrificing granular information. As a result, advertisers gain strategic and tactical insights to support budget allocation across time periods, campaigns and channels.

Mediatool is a professional media planning collaboration software for marketeers and agencies. Marketeers and agencies use it to get an overview of all their marketing activities, campaign plans and yearly summaries in one place as a virtual marketing assistant. It also makes it easier to manage and change media plans in real time, collaborate within and between teams, and analyse and discover which media actions are giving the greatest ROI by comparing media spend to business outcomes.

Deliverect is a SaaS platform that integrates online food delivery channels directly with a restaurant's point of sale and stock management systems. By automating order flow and centralizing menu management across all delivery platforms, it reduces manual errors and improves operational efficiency for food service businesses.

APICBASE is a food management SaaS platform that helps food service businesses run their kitchen operations more efficiently and profitably. Starting from recipe data, the platform automatically calculates ingredient quantities, manages inventory across multiple outlets, and generates preparation instructions — eliminating much of the manual work in kitchen management. It also helps businesses control food costs and waste, ensure compliance with allergen and nutritional regulations, and scale their menus and processes consistently across locations.

ValueBlue is the company behind BlueDolphin, a SaaS collaboration platform that can be used to map an organization’s digital landscape and business processes.Companies can lose their grip on the complex IT landscapes created by digital transformation. To reverse this situation, it is essential for companies to have a clear understanding of the relationships and dependencies between their IT landscape, their business processes and the underlying data.BlueDolphin combines all of the relevant data and translates it into management and improvement information with clear visualizations and reports.

REXai offers an AI-as-a-Service (AiaaS) solutions platform that enables companies to provide hyper-personalized experiences for their customers.Unlike labor intensive rule-based tools that require commerce and marketing professionals to collect data and micromanage rules in an attempt to make business and personalization decisions, the platform interprets the visitor’s intention based on real-time behavioral data, and aligns with pre-defined business goals when autonomously predicting which items or content to display throughout the customer journey.

SwipeGuide is a SaaS platform that enables manufacturers to quickly create and distribute digital work instructions and standard operating procedures. By replacing outdated PDFs and printed manuals with interactive, trackable guides, it helps frontline employees work more effectively while giving organizations the analytics to continuously improve their processes.

Roadmap is a customizable SaaS platform that streamlines corporate travel by integrating suppliers, policies, and traveler support in one place. It gives travel managers full oversight and policy control while providing business travelers with a personalized digital assistant that handles the logistics, so they can stay focused on their work.

PlayPass offers a plug-and-play infrastructure for access control and cashless payments at events.Large event businesses (such as open-air festivals and arenas) need technology to run their events. It’s the only way to manage processes and gather data to improve performance. They need to know who the guest is, they need to own the data, and they need to be in control of the transactions at their events. PlayPass is a software platform combined with a cashless RFID wristband payment system. Its infrastructure enables event businesses to improve processes, become data-driven organizations and create a better experience for guests.

TaxModel is a SaaS tax technology scaleup specializing in direct tax reporting, compliance and transfer pricing. The company bridges the gap between tax professionals and corporate and social requirements in terms of the cost-effectiveness of tax advice, tax behavior and transparency.

DataStories is a self-service analytics company that uses augmented intelligence to help formulated product manufacturers optimize their products. Their platform helps companies understand how complex combinations of ingredients, processing conditions, and other variables impact product performance — replacing the slow, expensive, trial-and-error experimentation that currently dominates the industry.

Oxynade offers a SaaS-based e-ticketing platform that enables ticketing agencies and venues to deliver modern, feature-rich ticketing experiences without the cost of building their own technology. Their all-in-one solution covers front and back office needs across a broad range of verticals, helping partners grow their businesses and stay competitive.
Synple was a Breda-based logistics startup that developed an "Uber-esque" freight capacity marketplace to match available truck capacity with demand.

L1nda is a cloud-based platform that simplifies the scheduling, finding, and paying of hospitality staff via mobile and desktop. Built with younger, digitally native workers in mind, the platform supports the flexible, dynamic planning that today's hospitality workforce expects.

The Next Ad is a social media advertising platform for companies involved in e-commerce. In-depth expertise and a focus on automation make digital advertising effortless and accessible.The platform helps businesses grow by making it easy for brands of all sizes to publish and optimize their advertising campaigns. The platform also provides insights into the effectiveness of digital advertising so businesses can improve the efficiency of their campaigns.

Nallian provides a cloud-based data-sharing platform that connects logistics partners — particularly in air cargo — enabling real-time collaboration across complex supply chains. Their platform allows entire cargo communities to operate in an integrated, transparent way, improving end-to-end efficiency without lengthy onboarding.

CustomerGauge is a Voice-of-the-Customer platform built specifically for B2B companies, using Net Promoter Score methodology to help them measure and improve customer experience and retention. By linking customer engagement data with revenue analytics, it enables businesses to prioritize the right accounts and take targeted actions for profitable growth.

Foleon is a SaaS platform that enables brands, publishers, and marketing agencies to create responsive, interactive digital magazines and marketing content. Their intuitive tool handles all the technical complexity without requiring developers, while also providing analytics to track engagement and generate leads.

24/i creates and deploys TV apps for every screen, from set-top boxes, SmartTVs and media players to game consoles, tablets and mobile phones.24/i was acquired by Amino Communications, part of Amino Technologies PLC (AMO.L)

Reasult offers financial forecasting and control software for the real estate market. In the current real estate market, there is an increasing need for transparency, sound financial control and risk management. Directors responsible for real estate are accountable for their investment decisions and want to be fully in control of their portfolios. Which is why Reasult’s financial forecasting and portfolio analysis solutions are the most widely used in the Netherlands.

iWelcome is a leading European SaaS provider of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, helping organizations securely manage digital identities across consumers, employees, partners, and IoT devices. Their cloud platform is built to handle complex enterprise security requirements while ensuring compliance with regulations like GDPR.

Collibra is the market leader in enterprise data governance and catalogue software.Data governance is a set of processes which ensure that important data assets are formally managed throughout the enterprise. Collibra brings business and IT together to govern data as an enterprise asset.Now more than ever, the most innovative companies are fueled by data. Data has become our most valuable asset. Collibra puts organizations back in control of their data, helping them comply with changing legislation, embrace emerging technologies and capture the information that enables them to design future-proof services and solutions.

Founded in 2004, Mirror 42 was a cloud Business Intelligence company specializing in KPI and time-series analytics. Their platform provided KPI dashboards, scorecards, and data visualization tools, which were integrated into ServiceNow to become ServiceNow Performance Analytics. Mirror42 was acquired in July 2013 by ServiceNow Inc. (NYSE: NOW)

Servoy offers a Platform as a Service (PaaS) solution for the development and deployment of cloud-based business applications anywhere, on any device.Enterprises are building more and more bespoke core applications that they see as a USP. Meanwhile, low-code platforms are operating at their technological limits when integrating and overlapping with core applications.Servoy is a high-productivity platform for the rapid development of complex applications. It helps organizations build enterprise-grade applications and transform their businesses faster. The platform includes advanced mobile capabilities and integrates easily with existing systems.

XVR Simulation develops VR-based training and assessment technology for safety and security professionals such as first responders. Their modular platform replaces costly, disruptive offline exercises with flexible, instructor-controlled simulations that deliver greater educational value at lower cost.

A Dutch software company specialized in semantic search and Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology, founded in 1999. Q-GO was acquired by RightNow Technologies in Jan 2011, later becoming part of Oracle's portfolio.

LeanApps Life (now part of Keylane) is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform specialized for individual and collective life insurance and pension administration. Primarily used in the Netherlands, Belgium, and the Caribbean, it streamlines policy management, underwriting, claims, and product configuration to enhance operational efficiency for insurers.

Asysco is a technology provider specializing in transforming legacy mainframe applications and COBOL code into modern, cost-effective solutions. Their turnkey approach allows organizations to preserve the value of their critical systems while enabling the flexibility needed for future innovation and growth.

Wisdom TMLC is an e-business solution for telecom operators, local government agencies, utility companies and health organizations, covering front and back offices. Founded in 1995, they provided total e-business solutions, including web application development, maintenance, system integration, and intranet/extranet services. The company specialized in front- and back-office solutions for sectors such as telecom, local government, utilities, and health, and was acquired by Ordina in 2006.

Propulsion is a B2B marketing and sales agency that bridges the gap between lead generation and sales by nurturing prospects early and qualifying their intent before handing them off. This ensures sales teams focus only on high-potential leads, while helping clients build a more structured and effective marketing process.

Minihouse provided specialized software for import and export customs compliance. In June 2010, Kewill plc, a provider of logistics and trade compliance software, acquired Minihouse to strengthen its European customs services.

Oxxio is an independent energy supplier, established in 2000, specializing in providing 100% green electricity and gas to residential and business customers. As a subsidiary of Eneco Energie, it focuses on sustainable, affordable energy, often positioning itself in the price-fighter segment
